title: CodeQuant: Unified Clustering and Quantization for Enhanced Outlier Smoothing in Low-Precision Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2604.10496v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Outliers have emerged as a fundamental bottleneck in preserving accuracy for low-precision large models, particularly within Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures that are increasingly central to large-scale language modeling. Under post-training quantization (PTQ), these outliers induce substantial quantization errors, leading to severe accuracy degradation. translated_title: CodeQuant：统一聚类与量化以增强低精度混合专家模型中的异常值平滑
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.10496v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：异常值已成为低精度大模型保持精度的根本瓶颈，尤其是在日益成为大规模语言建模核心的混合专家（MoE）架构中。在后训练量化（PTQ）下，这些异常值会引发显著的量化误差，导致严重的精度下降。尽管近期基于旋转的平滑技术通过重新分配异常值幅度来缓解该问题，但残余误差仍然存在，继续阻碍可靠的低精度部署。在本工作中，我们通过引入CodeQuant来应对这一挑战，这是一种统一的量化与聚类方案，通过可学习旋转平滑激活异常值，并将权重异常值吸收到为MoE精细调整的聚类中心中。该设计通过将极端值拟合到聚类中心内来减少其影响，从而降低量化误差，同时保持精度。
tldr: 本文提出CodeQuant，一种统一量化与聚类的方法，通过可学习旋转平滑激活异常值并将权重异常值吸收到聚类中心，有效降低低精度MoE模型中的量化误差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CodeQuant, a unified quantization-and-clustering approach that smooths activation outliers via learnable rotation and absorbs weight outliers into cluster centroids, effectively reducing quantization error in low-precision MoE models.
